title: Chromatic number of a join of graphs
statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be simple graphs on finite, nonempty vertex sets, and let $G \vee H$ denote their join, the graph obtained from the disjoint union of $G$ and $H$ by adding every edge between a vertex of $G$ and a vertex of $H$. Then the chromatic number of the join is the sum of the chromatic numbers of the two factors: \[ \chi(G \vee H) = \chi(G) + \chi(H). \]
hypotheses_covered: G a simple graph on a finite vertex set
H a simple graph on a finite vertex set
